feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: Breaking news, top national and world stories, politics, business and culture from NPR. Catch up on demand with NPR News Now, Up First and Consider This.

entry.title: Justice Department issues subpoenas to California election workers
entry.summary: Grand jury subpoenas sent to election workers in Los Angeles come amid escalating tensions between the Trump administration and California election officials over the state's voter rolls.

entry.title: Alaska's all-important Senate race is roiled by a report on alleged spoiler candidate
entry.summary: New reporting alleging Democratic efforts to prop up a spoiler candidate has roiled Alaska's all-important U.S. Senate race.

entry.title: Patrick Stewart, a perceptive patriarch in 'Star Trek' and 'X-Men,' dies at 86
entry.summary: Stewart was raised by an abusive father but became best known for playing kind, paternal leaders who united families of misfits.

entry.title: Some rural Republicans in California say redistricting has left them without a voice
entry.summary: California's far northeastern corner used to be a reliably red congressional district. But Proposition 50 carved it up, meaning many voters there may soon have a Democrat representing them in D.C.

entry.title: What killed 500-plus penguins? How scientists solved the mystery
entry.summary: The penguins that perished lived on the Danger Islands in Antarctica. The prime suspect was avian flu. Researchers were surprised by what they found.

entry.title: Lost your spark? The "silent sister" of depression, and a quiz to spot her
entry.summary: Always busy, but rarely joyful? Allison Aubrey and Juana Summers discuss a tool to spot "high functioning depression."

entry.title: Even birds get jet lagged, study shows
entry.summary: A species of seabirds appears to become disoriented on flights back to its nest due to shifting time zones.

entry.title: Fishing is a key issue in Alaska's tight U.S. Senate race
entry.summary: Alaska's U.S. Senate race is embroiled in an emotional fight over fish. Many in the state rely upon salmon to feed their families but those fish and others are increasingly hard to find.

entry.title: US and Japan agree to establish a Japanese facility for joint missile production
entry.summary: The announcement Wednesday is the latest action by the allies, who have repeatedly expressed alarm over China's growing assertiveness in Asia.

entry.title: China elevates a military general to the Politburo and seeks to strengthen party discipline
entry.summary: This move comes about a year before President Xi Jinping is expected to secure his fourth five-year term.
